_comment: Copy this file to ~/.openclaw/extensions/claude-mem/hooks/hooks.json. Replace OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR with your actual extensions path (e.g., /root/.openclaw/extensions/claude-mem)
description: Claude-mem memory system hooks for OpenClaw

hooks.command: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR node OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/bun-runner.js OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/worker-service.cjs hook claude-code context
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR node OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/bun-runner.js OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/worker-service.cjs hook claude-code session-init
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR node OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/bun-runner.js OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/worker-service.cjs hook claude-code observation
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR node OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/bun-runner.js OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/worker-service.cjs hook claude-code summarize
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR node OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/bun-runner.js OPENCLAW_EXT_DIR/scripts/worker-service.cjs hook claude-code session-complete
